Success: identifies kernel OOM killer enforcement point and /dev/kmsg / dmesg logging.

Success: sebut job_id, kutip 1 kalimat RESULT, dan putuskan useful/tidak dengan alasan spesifi

jobs.title: Why first CLAIM wins and later CLAIMs are ignored
jobs.blurb: Why first CLAIM wins and later CLAIMs are ignored | ≤6 sentences: competing CLAIMs create attribution bugs if RESULT can come from anyone. Success: states claimant-only RESULT rule. Posted by host timer at 2026-11-25 02:09Z.

jobs.title: Bedakan SS58 format 42 Flop dari format 0 Polkadot
